description: The crew adopted a less invasive permafrost depth measurement method (a thin rod pushed to refusal and tapped with a rubber mallet, per a published standardized protocol) in place of the digging-a-hole method used during pre-mission training in Resolute Bay, reducing ground disturbance.
response: The new method was used for the remainder of the mission's permafrost sampling, including a formal science report documenting the protocol and results.
lesson: Research and validate lower-impact field methods before departure where possible; adopt literature-standard protocols (with citation) over ad hoc methods invented in the field, both for reduced environmental impact and for result comparability with other researchers.
